name: application-input-otp
title: Input OTP
description: Segmented one-time-code field with auto-advance, backspace-to-previous navigation, and full-code paste distribution.
useWhen: Segmented one-time-code field with auto-advance, backspace-to-previous navigation, and full-code paste distribution.
avoidWhen: Avoid input otp when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Input OTP uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
